headline: “The team made me feel <mark>really special.</mark>”
name: Lokesh K.
text:
Everyone was so <mark class="w">polite and welcoming</mark>!

headline: “Rohit Rajput made the entire process <mark>effortless.</mark>”
name: Himanshu K.
text: Outstanding service at Dee Emm Mahindra, Sector 35, Gurgaon! Dealing with an insurance claim can often be a headache, but Rohit Rajput made the entire process <mark class="w">effortless</mark>. He managed everything from the <mark class="w">insurance paperwork to regular status updates</mark> and ensured a <mark class="w">seamless, timely handover</mark> of my car. Thank you to Rohit and the entire Dee Emm Mahindra team for the <mark class="w">top-notch professionalism</mark> and hassle-free experience!
